sources.title: Interests Section of the Islamic Republic of Iran: How to Apply for a Visa to Iran
sources.publisher: Interests Section of the Islamic Republic of Iran, Embassy of Pakistan, Washington, D.C.
sources.officialityEvidence: The live document identifies the Interests Section of the Islamic Republic of Iran at the Embassy of Pakistan in Washington, D.C.; it is revised October 2025 and gives that office's workflow for applicants residing in the United States or Canada.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The visa will only be issued electronically, and a copy will be sent to the email address provided.

sources.title: Spain Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Iran travel recommendations
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union and Cooperation
sources.officialityEvidence: Spain's live Tehran Embassy travel guidance is published on exteriores.gob.es and directly addresses Spanish nationals entering Iran; it was last updated 13 April 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Irán dejó de expedir visados en frontera (visa on arrival) desde el inicio de la pandemia.

sources.title: Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Iran passport and visa
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: Denmark's live Foreign Ministry passport-and-visa page says Iranian authorities supplied the rules for Danish citizens and was last updated 4 June 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: prisen afhænger af om det er udstedt online, på ambassaden eller i lufthavnen ved ankomst.

sources.title: Iran Ministry of Foreign Affairs eVisa portal
sources.officialityEvidence: The live mfa.ir service identifies itself as managed by the Evisa Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. It says online filing is only the first step and some nationalities or visa types require in-person processing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Electronically submitting your online application is the FIRST STEP in the visa application process.

conflicts.explanation: Current Spanish guidance says Iran has not officially resumed border visas and requires pre-application, but does not establish whether the resulting ordinary tourist visa is electronic or mission-issued.

unresolved.reason: Spain confirms that ordinary Spanish visitors need a visa, that border visas have not officially resumed and that pre-application is required. It does not establish whether the final visa is issued electronically or by a mission; do not replace the unsupported arrival fallback with another taxonomy label.

No current Swiss or Iranian official source directly establishes the ordinary Swiss-passport tourist visa's actual issuance point. Iran's live eVisa portal says online filing is only the first step and that some cases require in-person processing; do not infer from its generic application.

No current Finnish or Iranian official source directly maps an ordinary Finnish passport to an Iranian tourist visa issuance point. The generic MFA application is not nationality-specific evidence and cannot establish the arrival fallback.

No current Swedish or Iranian official source directly maps an ordinary Swedish passport to one Iranian tourist-visa issuance route. Do not infer a border or electronic visa from the generic MFA form or portal availability.

No current Luxembourg or Iranian official source directly establishes the ordinary Luxembourg-passport tourist visa's actual issuance point. The generic MFA application is not an eligibility or issuance result for this passport.

No current Republic of Korea or Iranian official source directly maps an ordinary South Korean passport to one Iranian tourist-visa issuance route. Do not infer a status from a generic portal or a visa application form.

No current Irish or Iranian official source directly establishes the ordinary Irish-passport tourist visa's actual issuance point. The MFA portal's first-step filing language does not resolve electronic, mission or arrival issuance.

No current Portuguese or Iranian official source directly establishes the ordinary Portuguese-passport tourist visa's actual issuance point. Do not infer a visa-on-arrival route from general Iranian portal material.

No current Austrian or Iranian official source directly establishes the ordinary Austrian-passport tourist visa's actual issuance point. Current Austrian guidance is a travel prohibition and not a route classification; generic Iranian filing is insufficient.

Denmark confirms a visa requirement for stays up to 90 days, but its current guidance says issuance may be online, at an embassy or at the airport on arrival. It does not identify one nationality-wide ordinary-passport issuance baseline, so do not select one of those routes.

No current Maltese or Iranian official source directly establishes the ordinary Maltese-passport tourist visa's actual issuance point. The MFA portal's generic application is not sufficient nationality-specific evidence.

No current New Zealand or Iranian official source directly maps an ordinary New Zealand passport to one Iranian tourist-visa issuance route. A generic direction to consult destination authorities cannot establish the arrival fallback.

No current Greek or Iranian official source directly establishes the ordinary Greek-passport tourist visa's actual issuance point. The MFA portal does not publish a direct Greek result, and omission cannot establish the fallback.

Iran's current Washington Interests Section instructions establish electronic issuance only for applicants currently residing in the United States or Canada and require documents to be mailed to that office. They do not establish a nationality-wide ordinary Canadian-passport visitor baseline for holders resident elsewhere.
